Proposed_Method: SensorSCAN method combining self-supervised learning (SSL) with Transformer-based feature extractor and deep clustering (modified SCAN algorithm) for unsupervised fault detection, with semi-supervised fine-tuning option.

Paper_ID: 2-Open-Set Fault Diagnosis in Multimode Processes via Fine-Grained Deep Feature Representation
Citation: Li G, Atoui MA, Li X. Open-Set Fault Diagnosis in Multimode Processes via Fine-Grained Deep Feature Representation.
Core_Problem: Open-set fault diagnosis in multimode processes where samples of same health state show multiple cluster distributions due to different operating modes, making it difficult to identify unknown faults.
Proposed_Method: Fine-grained Clustering and Rejection Network (FGCRN): integrates multiscale depthwise convolution, BiGRU, temporal attention, distance-based loss for intra-class compactness, unsupervised clustering for fine-grained representations, and EVT for unknown fault identification.

Datasets_Used: Tennessee Eastman Process (TEP) and Continuous Stirred Tank Reactor (CSTR) datasets; also tested on Intelligent Process Control Test Facility (IPCTF) real system.
Main_Result: Achieves 98.03% average accuracy on TEP, 98.24% on CSTR, and 99.69% on IPCTF, significantly outperforming OpenMax, MaxLogit, GEN, and other OOD detection methods; FAR reduced to 1.28% on TEP.

Datasets_Used: PRONTO benchmark dataset (multiphase flow, normal/air leakage/diverted flow, video frames); NEU surface defect dataset (6 types, 1800 images).
Main_Result: RWGAN-GP improves accuracy: PRONTO: 92.0% -> 99.3% (VGG), 67.3% -> 74.4% (SVM); NEU: 54.0% -> 67.3%; outperforms GAN, WGAN-GP, SAGAN, MSG-GAN; generated samples show high similarity (cosine 0.9732, SSIM 0.5908).
Limitations: Limited to image data; requires careful hyperparameter tuning; not validated on time-series or other data types; computational cost.
Future_Work: Evaluate on more industrial datasets; improve robustness to noise and anomalies; apply to other data modalities (time-series, signals).
Static_or_Dynamic: Static + justification: RWGAN-GP and classifier are trained offline on historical data; data augmentation is static; no online model adaptation.
Single_or_MultiTier: Single-tier + justification: focuses on single-domain industrial datasets (PRONTO, NEU) with multiple fault classes; no multi-tier or cross-domain transfer.

RQ_Relevance: High
Contradicts_Aligns: Not determinable from single paper
Terminology_Definitions: Generative adversarial network (GAN), Residual network, Wasserstein distance, Gradient penalty, Imbalanced data, Fault diagnosis, Data augmentation.
Reusable_Figures: Yes + description: Figures include GAN/WGAN/RWGAN-GP structures, training loss curves, generated image examples, similarity calculations, confusion matrices, accuracy comparisons.
